subject: Request: APAC healthcare reference roster + short case-study for Luminara deal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Request: APAC healthcare reference roster + short case-study for Luminara deal

Team —

Heads-up: Luminara Health is in final procurement (legal + SOC/audit loop) and asked for two reference calls and a 1‑page APAC healthcare case study that highlights on-prem/VPC deployments and latency SLAs. This is a late-stage expansion opportunity (see HubSpot link).

Why this matters: they want proof we’ve done healthcare workloads in APAC with data residency and HSM/KMS integration — specifically low-latency inference for triage routing (sub-500ms p95). The buyer (Asha, CTO) also wants to hear from a customer who did a private deployment and kept costs predictable.

Ask: Monica — can you pull a shortlist (2–3 contacts) who: (a) are APAC-based or ran APAC deployments, (b) work in healthcare/healthtech, and (c) are comfortable on a 30‑min reference call this week? Please prioritize folks who can speak to private deployment + compliance.

Stephanie — can you draft a one‑page APAC healthcare case study / customer highlight we can share with Asha/Tom? Focus on deployment architecture (VPC/on-prem), latency numbers, and a 1–2 sentence exec quote. Keep it customer-anonymous if needed.

Rishi — heads-up for SOC/Security Qs: Asha may ask about audit logs and key management — if you can prepare a 1‑paragraph summary we can include in the doc that’d be great.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short brief from Luminara (their ask) and a blank template for the one-pager.

Thanks — I need this turned around quickly; they indicated a buying committee call on Wed (6/2).

— Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks, Jonas. I can field this. Quick responses below and next steps: 

Shortlist (available this week):
- Maya Srinivasan (Head of ML Ops, WellWell Health) — ran a VPC deployment in SG, comfortable on camera, can speak to latency and cost reductions. (apac region)
- Diego Fernandez (Solutions Lead, MediBridge) — led an on-prem rollout in AU, strong on compliance + deployment timeline.
- Evelyn Hart (Sr. Customer Engineer, CareSync) — ran hybrid private + hosted setup, can discuss KMS and audit logs.

I’ll ping them now (internal note: use incentive: short thank-you gift card + case-study review copy). I’ll aim to lock 2 calls (Maya + Diego) for Tue/Wed.

Rishi, I’ll include your paragraph on SOC audit logs in the one-pager. Stephanie, I’ll share two bullet highlights you can drop into the one-pager.

Attaching the roster I started (redwood-apac-refs.csv) — names, timezone windows, and quick notes.

— Monica

monica@redwood.com

From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@luminarahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@luminarahealth.com>, procurement@luminarahealth.com
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 01:12:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Request: APAC healthcare reference roster + short case-study for Luminara deal

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the quick response and for coordinating. A few clarifications from our side before calls: 

1) We have two technical topics we care most about: deployment model (we prefer VPC/on-prem) and latency at p95 under concurrent inference (we run bursty triage workloads).
2) Can the reference calls include someone who signed off on security/compliance items (not just engineering) — a brief mention from a compliance or security contact is helpful for our procurement. 
3) We’d prefer short 30‑min calls (max) and 3–4 bullet takeaways we can include in our internal procurement memo.

If possible, can you also share a redacted one-page case highlight before the calls? That will speed approvals.

Regards,
Asha Reddy
CTO, Luminara Health
asha.reddy@luminarahealth.com
+65 9123 4456

- Tue 2026-06-01 09:00 SGT (30 min) — Maya Srinivasan (WellWell) + security PD on call
- Wed 2026-06-02 14:00 SGT (30 min) — Diego Fernandez (MediBridge)

Draft bullets for calls / memo (feel free to copy straight into procurement material):
- Deployment: Private VPC with customer-supplied VPC peering and optional on-prem gateway; KMS/HSM integrated for key control.
- Performance: WellWell Health reported median inference latency ~120ms and p95 ~420ms across a 50k requests/day triage workload after batching and KV caching.
- Economics: Predictable unit cost via reserved capacity + intelligent batching reduced per-token cost ~28% vs prior hosted baseline.

Rishi — your SOC/Security blurb: "Redwood provides tenant-level audit logs, configurable retention, and HSM-backed key management; we completed customer-facing SOC 2 evidence and can share redacted audit artifacts under NDA."

Monica — I’ve redacted company names where requested; please add the compliance contact names for the calls and send calendar invites.
